added_failures_note: the reviewed run's after arm head-audit-tests.log records 671 passed EXIT=0 with no failing id, so nothing was added against base; the base arm baseline-audit-tests.log is truncated at 42% and reaches no summary, so the base failure set is unreadable and the zero rests on the fully green head arm

findings.text: blocking: `store = stores[0]` uses the store `_citation_stores` returns first, which is the repository, not the worktree the run worked in as the docstring at reports.py:1438 claims. In a real dispatch the recorded repo is the main checkout (record repo=/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/reckon, worktree the detached tree), and that checkout does not hold the run's unmerged commit, so `git -C <repo> diff <base>` shows the repository's own changes since base and never the lines the run added. Measured: stores[0] resolves to the main checkout; `diff base` there yields only docs/plans/a-moved-head-is-reviewed.html and four docs/state JSON files (no production Python), while the same call against the worktree yields reckon/crew/reports.py and the new test file. The plan-label half of the goal therefore never fires on the run it audits.

follow-on: the five plan-label cases pass `worktree=repo, repository=repo` (the fixture returns one directory for both arguments), so `_citation_stores` returns a single store and the test cannot observe which store the check reads. The production shape, where repository and worktree differ, is never exercised, so the blocking store-selection defect above is invisible to this suite. The log-half cases are unaffected and are sound.

item_verdicts.call_sites: one production call site, reckon/crew_run_commands.py:663, the check-manifest command a worker runs before finishing; reckon/crew.py:193 is only the module facade export list, not a caller.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 65f1b1d94; the single commit 7c52a3d39 adds three files (reports.py +266, the new test file, the evidence fragment), all inside the declared write paths; the label-check helpers read the diff from the wrong store.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_manifest_evidence_is_checked.py passing the section cases, no added failure among the audit-calling test files, and a logged negative control; gate-new-test.log records 11 passed EXIT=0, head-audit-tests.log 671 passed EXIT=0, and negative-control-missing-exit.log records EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that audit_manifest refuses a test log without its literal command and terminal EXIT line, and an added production comment citing a plan section; reports.py:1287 fires the log half, but reports.py:1449 reads the wrong tree so the label half does not fire in production.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate results, the negative control with its declared mutation, follow_ons none and blockers none, and does not disclose the truncated base arm.

justifications.durability: negative-control-missing-exit.log restores the dropped EXIT= check and test_a_log_with_no_exit_record_is_a_finding fails at tests/test_a_manifest_evidence_is_checked.py:100 (assert 0 == 1), so the log half is guarded; the label cases at tests/test_a_manifest_evidence_is_checked.py:175 pass one directory as both trees and so cannot fail on the store-selection defect.
justifications.evidence: gate-new-test.log and head-audit-tests.log are complete and match the done_when, but baseline-audit-tests.log stops at 42% with no summary line and no EXIT record, so the base arm can show no result and the no-added-failure claim rests only on the green head arm.
justifications.fit: the findings are strings appended to the existing list, matching _gate_log_revision_findings at reckon/crew/reports.py:1158, and no symbol or comment carries a plan label; the docstring at reports.py:1438 states the diff is read from the worktree while reports.py:1449 reads the repository.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:1449 reads the repository store, so in a real dispatch the added-plan-label refusal of the goal never fires on the run's own change, leaving only the log half delivered.
justifications.reuse: reports.py:1313 delegates to gate_command_prose at reckon/crew/promotion_gate.py:182, the owner of the command-shape judgement, and a search of reckon/crew for an added-lines-with-line-numbers reader found only name-only and numstat diff readers in promotion_scope.py and promotion_evidence.py, none owning this capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path the diff changes (reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_a_manifest_evidence_is_checked.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-review-loop-runs-without-hand-steps/a-manifest-evidence-is-checked.html) is inside the five declared write paths, and the declared-but-unused promotion_gate.py and figures path are untouched rather than stray.
